summary: REPAIR V3-04 candidate resolves both must-fix findings from RUN_35179481461. (1) Currency is now included in the expense modification detection in app/(tabs)/balances.tsx: the condition at line 328 adds `oldEntry.currency !== newEntry.currency`, so a currency-only edit (CHF→EUR with identical amount/paidBy/participants/splitMode) triggers the remove-old + apply-new delta path. All ledger-affecting ExpenseEntry fields are now compared (amountMinor, currency, paidByMemberId, participantMemberIds, splitMode, customShares); non-ledger fields (title, note, category, occurredAt) are correctly excluded since they do not affect the all-time money snapshot. Three new tests in __tests__/domain/cost-gates-v3-04.test.ts perform a currency-only edit and assert the all-time moneyByCurrency snapshot equals calculateFinancialBalancesByCurrency full replay: the old CHF effect is zeroed/removed, the new EUR balance is created (a=+1000/b=-1000 for a 2000-minor equal split), and financialLedgerIsZeroSum holds per currency. A second test covers a combined amount+currency edit, and a third simulates the exact balances.tsx detection condition; an independent mutation probe (removing the currency comparison from the simulated condition) makes the third test fail, confirming it guards the detection logic. (2) Claim #8 was reworded from 'Screen-level:' to 'Data-level: delta handler re-reads only the changed collection, proving bounded repo calls (no full re-read on focus or signal)' — option (b) of the task — and the tests at lines 1166-1276 now substantiate it with repository read counts (a contribution signal re-reads only contributions, expenses/settlements are not re-read; total reads bounded at 3/1/1). No 'Screen-level' wording remains in the file. The actual screen behavior matches the claim: useFocusEffect only full-reloads when the household changed, otherwise the data-change signal drives incremental delta updates. Trusted verification passed (exit 0: typecheck, 180 tests green, Expo export, prebuild, native debug BUILD SUCCESSFUL) and an independent `npm run check` reproduces typecheck-clean with 13 suites / 180 tests green, including all V3-01/V3-02/V3-03 regression suites. Candidate delta is exactly two files (balances.tsx +1, cost-gates-v3-04.test.ts +209/-2); no governance, directives, state or report files were modified by the builder. No chrono, premium/paywall/subscription/entitlement, V2 warm/self-care design, cross-currency netting, silent unit conversion or destructive reset behavior introduced. No must-fix finding remains.

findings.problem: RESOLVED — currency-only expense edit was invisible to the Balances delta handler. The modification detection compared amountMinor/paidByMemberId/participantMemberIds/splitMode/customShares but not currency, so a CHF→EUR edit (identical amount/paidBy/participants/splitMode) fell through `continue`, the old CHF effect was never removed and the new EUR effect never applied, leaving the all-time moneyByCurrency snapshot stale vs full replay. The candidate adds `oldEntry.currency !== newEntry.currency` to the condition (line 328), so a changed currency now triggers the remove-old + apply-new delta path.
findings.evidence: balances.tsx line 328 now reads `oldEntry.currency !== newEntry.currency ||` inside the modified-entry condition (lines 326-333). The Add-tab edit form exposes an editable currency input (add.tsx lines 891-894) and persists it (add.tsx line 532 `currency: eForm.currency.toUpperCase()`), confirming the scenario is reachable. Three new tests (cost-gates-v3-04.test.ts lines 959-1164) cover currency-only, amount+currency, and the exact detection condition; all assert delta snapshot == calculateFinancialBalancesByCurrency full replay with per-currency zero-sum. Mutation probe: removing the currency comparison from the simulated condition fails the detection test (deltaEur undefined).
findings.requiredFix: None — verified resolved. Do not remove the currency comparison from the expense modification detection.
findings.verification: Edit an existing expense changing only its currency (CHF→EUR), emit 'expense', and assert snapshot.moneyByCurrency equals calculateFinancialBalancesByCurrency full replay: old currency zeroed/removed, new currency balance created, zero-sum per currency. Covered by the three new tests; mutation probe confirms the detection test fails without the currency comparison.
